title: ShieldCare Food Spoilage Allowance: Entry Against the Claim
content:
## The request this covers

A customer may ask for the food spoiled by a covered appliance failure to be met. The plan pays an
allowance for it alongside whatever the claim is settled by. The allowance for spoiled food is worked out
only after every cost the claim has already been approved for stands booked as paid against the plan's
cover. The allowance never exceeds the plan's food spoilage cover, and it is paid alongside the settlement
of the claim rather than inside the plan's per-claim limit.

## Recording the allowance

The allowance is recorded with `book_spoilage_allowance_79e3e314`, a care desk tool that is unlocked and
then called by the agent working the claim on the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan. One call books a
single allowance entry against the named claim on the named plan, as money paid to the customer for food
spoiled by the failed appliance, and takes the same amount off the cover still available on that plan. The
customer sees the allowance on the claim alongside any other settlement, and the reduced cover on the plan.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the claim sits on, read from the plan record retrieved for this customer. |
| `claim_reference` | Copied verbatim: the claim reference the retailer issued when the incident was taken, character for character from the claim entry on the plan's history or from what the customer reads out, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `covered_item_serial` | Copied verbatim: the serial number of the covered item the claim concerns, character for character from the plan record or from what the customer reads off the item, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `allowance_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: the spoilage allowance being paid, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |
| `payment_method` | An enumerated value: how the money goes out, one of `card_on_file`, a credit put back to the payment card held on the profile; `store_credit`, an amount posted as store credit on the profile; `bank_transfer`, money sent to the customer's bank account; `in_store_cash`, money handed over at a branch counter; `business_invoice`, an amount credited on the invoice account a business profile settles on terms. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new allowance entry, a string
beginning pca_, the claim and plan it was booked against, the allowance paid in USD to two decimal places,
and the cover still remaining on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Spoilage
allowance booked" means the money was paid and the plan's remaining cover was reduced.
